rejections.title: KILLSWITCH.md — The AI Agent Emergency Stop Standard
rejections.rationale: The document is a self-published, explicitly unofficial prompt/file convention rather than a non-bypassable emergency-stop mechanism or conformance standard. Its domain was advertised for sale, implementation/adoption evidence is absent, and several legal descriptions require primary-source verification. Counting it as a technical standard would inflate evidence quality and confuse instruction-following with enforced containment.
rejections.allowedUse: Discovery vocabulary only: it may illustrate current interest in a KILLSWITCH.md convention and help distinguish prompt/file signaling from W3 enforcement and conformance. It may not support security, regulatory, adoption or novelty claims.
reconsiderationTriggers: A stable accountable standards body adopts a normative successor with transparent governance.
Multiple independent implementations demonstrate enforced stop behavior and publish a conformance suite.
The legal statements are replaced by precise citations to current primary authorities.
